## Problem
When running `frai gate init --ci`, the `--ci` flag wasn't being passed to the frai-gate CLI because the main `frai` program was parsing it as its own option (defined at line 605), removing it from the arguments passed to the gate subcommand.

## Solution
I modified the gate command's action handler to extract arguments directly from `process.argv` (lines 752-753):
```typescript
const gateIndex = process.argv.indexOf('gate');
const gateArgs = gateIndex !== -1 ? process.argv.slice(gateIndex + 1) : args;
```

This bypasses Commander's option parsing at the main program level and ensures all flags intended for the gate subcommand—including `--ci`—are properly forwarded to the frai-gate CLI.
